name: Applied Digital Delta Forge 2
summary: Applied Digital's fifth AI factory campus, on about 160 acres of a nearly 1,300-acre site north of Brookwood Parkway in Brookwood, Tuscaloosa County, Alabama. In June 2026 the company announced a 15-year lease of 210 MW of critical IT load to an unnamed US high investment-grade hyperscaler, worth about USD 5.2 billion in base-term revenue, naming only a southern state. Applied Digital confirmed the Brookwood site in September 2026; local reports gave an initial capital investment of about USD 3.29 billion and about 1.26 million square feet of data center space. Construction was set to begin on 1 October 2026, with initial operations expected in Q1 2028.

location.note: Local reports place the campus north of the 17000 block of Brookwood Parkway. No geocoder was used; coordinates are the Brookwood city point from its Wikipedia article.

parties.name: Tuscaloosa County Economic Development Authority
parties.note: Signed off on the project in September 2026; Applied Digital committed USD 270 million in community benefit payments to the authority over 20 years.

metrics.note: Critical IT load leased for 15 years to an unnamed US high investment-grade hyperscaler; the release puts base-term revenue at about USD 5.2 billion.
Initial capital investment figure reported with the local incentive package; reports also round it to more than USD 3.2 billion from Applied Digital and its tenant.
An earlier state environmental permit application had described about 2 million square feet.
Campus footprint within a site of nearly 1,300 acres.

milestones.note: Applied Digital announced the 210 MW lease at Delta Forge 2 in an unnamed southern state.
Alabama's Department of Environmental Management approved a permit application for a data center in Brookwood, later confirmed as this project.
Applied Digital confirmed the Brookwood location and the county economic development authority approved the incentive package.
Scheduled construction start reported with the incentive terms; the company's 7 October 2026 results list the campus as under construction.
Anticipated start of initial operations; local reporting gives completion by the end of 2028.

notes: The tenant is not named; Applied Digital says it is the same US high investment-grade hyperscaler as two of its other leases. Renewal options could lift lease revenue to about USD 12.7 billion over a 30-year total term. The June 2026 release describes proprietary waterless cooling for the campus. No source opened names the utility or a dedicated power arrangement for the campus. Local reports put 20-year taxes and community payments at about USD 440.7 million, against about USD 314.5 million in tax abatements.
